problem_type: Model-facing lane contracts omit runtime capability and authority facts
symptom: Human DeepSeek transcript cycles groups, guesses invalid create shape, sees empty context, promises nonexistent confirmation, ignores interruption and quotes stale budget.
direct_cause: Incremental tool menu is advertised as complete; examples omit candidate; preview is advertised without host implementation; unbounded JSON is line-truncated; approval decisions are absent from model context.
class_root: Host projections do not derive model-visible affordances, authority and bounded results from their existing owners.
affected_population: Every provider using the desktop lane, all document sizes and queued inputs
entry_points: Native group request and domain tool result
Desktop workspace and singleShot provider context

external_sources.purpose: Installed harness argument validation, hooks and steering boundary verified; see five-product prior art plan.

invariants: Core tools remain advertised after group switching
Lane preview is absent; external contract retains preview
Default context is bounded and scoped; long single-line results retain a nonempty head
Approval prose follows actual policy and decisions; no global spending budget is projected
Steer releases pending approval before the next request
generality_proof: All providers cross the same model-visible schema, prompt, result and user input boundaries. Native pi queues remain the single owner; no model-specific branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project approval, error help and interruption semantics

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Core menu and added/retired response share laneToolMenu
Generation context summary before public truncation
Workspace and singleShot both resolve provider content here

recurrence.reason: Every new session and large context can reproduce the same missing projection.

prevention.invariant: Model sees only supported affordances and runtime authority facts.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported operations fail schema validation; steering denies the pending action; no global budget is injected.
prevention.strategy: Derive descriptions from canonical schemas and approval decisions, omit global budgets and bound tool output at the lane boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace misleading menu and id-bearing receipt prose in place; retain structured receipts.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Upstream harness supporting schema-error result hooks
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse native steer, followUp and validation; immediate AJV failures bypass after_tool, so provider-message projection adds example without revalidating.
exit_criteria: When upstream routes preparation errors through result hooks, move example projection into that hook and retain wire regression.

migration: No stored-state migration; existing sessions receive current prompt and schema on next request.
residual_risks: Real DeepSeek final sample: first-tool accuracy 1/3 requested turns (1/1 actual tool calls), task completion 2/3; paid generation remains outside this lane and belongs to B4.

C47 prompt is present but the real read-only response still exceeds three lines. Earlier samples also overstepped read-only intent and claimed generation; a later passing interruption cannot prove those model behavior risks absent.
Original B1 gates stopped at check:fresh-base. B1-finish now authorizes integrating main; complete gates and push receipts are required before delivery.

invariant_owner_layer.why: All requests and running messages cross this host; desktop input absence of budget injection is checked independently.
